init.title: YouTube Playlists
init.description: Choose which playlists to import, and how clicking a video should play it.

data.playlist_pattern: Pattern (e.g. HA* for a prefix, *Podcast* to match anywhere)

script.title: Script playback
script.description: This script is called with a video_id when a video is clicked.

media_player.title: Media player playback
media_player.description: Only works with Android TV entities set up via the Android TV (ADB) integration, with ADB debugging enabled on the device. If the TV is off, it is turned on and the media player is asked to reconnect until it comes online (up to the online timeout); then we wait the settle delay, set the volume and launch the video.

data.play_power_on_entity: Entity to use for turning on the TV (e.g. a button that powers it on; optional)
data.play_volume_entity: Media player to set the volume on (e.g. the TV, when the Android TV device is a stick plugged into it; empty = the media player above)
data.play_settle_delay: Settle delay (seconds to wait once the TV is online, before launching)
data.play_online_timeout: Online timeout (max seconds from turning the TV on until it must be online; default 90)

error.pattern_required: Enter a pattern, or switch back to "All playlists".

options.media_player: Play directly on a media player entity
